### Step 1 — Scene
A light Asian-style meal: six maki sushi pieces, one fresh rice-paper roll, a shredded chicken and vegetable salad, and a foamy milk-based drink. Both central plates appear to belong to the meal.

### Step 2 — Vessels
- **Left side plate:** approximately 21 cm diameter; area ≈ **346 cm²**.
- **Salad plate:** approximately 22 cm diameter; area ≈ **380 cm²**.
- **Mug:** approximately 8 cm internal diameter; cross-sectional area ≈ **50 cm²**.

### Steps 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
Area percentages refer to each item's own vessel. Overlapping salad ingredients are allocated separate shares to avoid counting the same footprint twice.

| Visible item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Six maki pieces: rice, nori, mixed fillings | 32% of left plate | 111 × 1.8 = 200 ml | 0.85 | 170 g | 150 | 255 kcal |
| Fresh rice-paper roll with pale vegetable/noodle filling | 20% of left plate | 69 × 2.0 = 138 ml | 0.80 | 110 g | 140 | 154 kcal |
| Shredded cooked chicken | 25% of salad plate | 95 × 1.1 = 105 ml | 0.95 | 100 g | 165 | 165 kcal |
| Shredded cabbage and herbs | 50% of salad plate | 190 × 2.0 = 380 ml | 0.20 | 76 g | 25 | 19 kcal |
| Carrot and red pepper strips | 8% of salad plate | 30 × 1.0 = 30 ml | 0.60 | 18 g | 30 | 5 kcal |
| Light dressing visible beneath salad | 3% of salad plate | 11 × 0.9 = 10 ml | 1.00 | 10 g | 250 | 25 kcal |
| Foamy milk-based drink, assumed unsweetened | 100% of mug | 50 × 5.1 = 255 ml | 0.90 | 230 g | 55 | 127 kcal |

**Coverage check:** approximately **52%** of the left plate and **86%** of the salad plate are covered. Dressing composition and drink type are uncertain.

### Step 8 — Sanity check
The solid food totals approximately **484 g and 623 kcal**, plausible for six small sushi pieces, a fresh roll, and a substantial chicken salad. Including the drink gives approximately **714 g and 750 kcal**. A reasonable energy uncertainty is about ±25%, chiefly from fillings, dressing, and the drink.
